feed.title: Prime Medicine Gets FDA Green Light for Gene Editing Study
feed.summary: Prime Medicine (NASDAQ: PRME) has received FDA clearance for its Investigational New Drug (IND) application for PM647, a gene-editing therapy for Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency (AATD). The company plans to initiate a global Phase 1/2 clinical trial to assess the safety and efficacy of PM647, which aims to correct the E342K (Pi*Z) mutation in the SERPINA1 gene. PM647 is designed to restore functional M-AAT protein levels to address both liver and lung complications of AATD.

feed.title: Kroger shoppers are losing money as shocking study reveals hundreds of pricing errors
feed.summary: A new study by the Center for Responsible Food Business (CRFB) reveals that Kroger stores in Ohio have been overcharging customers due to widespread pricing errors. Government inspections found 644 incorrect prices across 389 inspections from 2022 to mid-2026, with overcharges occurring about three times more often than undercharges. Customers were often charged significantly more than the advertised shelf price, with one instance showing a 55% overcharge on eggs due to digital coupon failures.

feed.title: Cyber Threats Top Business Concerns Again as AI Reshapes Risk, Travelers Survey Shows

Despite increased cyber defense and insurance adoption, a notable gap exists between AI use and governance, creating new risks. The report emphasizes the need for organizations to treat AI-related cyber risk as a core business issue.

feed.title: Apple's $1.25M gift card scam settlement could pay Canadians who lost money to phone fraudsters since 2016
feed.summary: Apple has agreed to a $1.25 million class-action settlement for Canadians who lost money to gift card scams since 2016. While Apple denies wrongdoing, eligible Canadians who never received a full refund may receive partial compensation once the settlement is approved and a distribution protocol is established.
